root_cause_label: Agent assumed editing /app/src/Makefile and wrapping it with a delegating /app/Makefile was sufficient, never verifying that /app/test_program must exist after make; the wrapper guarantees the binary lands in /app/src/test_program instead.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent edited /app/src/Makefile and then created a delegating /app/Makefile that left the executable at /app/src/test_program instead of /app/test_program, while its local verification only checked output.txt content and never confirmed the binary location the test suite requires.
t_err_evidence: Step 10: Agent edits /app/src/Makefile with correct gfortran/OpenMP flags but directs all build work to the src subdirectory; it acts on the false premise that building in /app/src and later wrapping it satisfies the benchmark requirement for /app/test_program, never pausing to verify the expected artifact location.
t_commit_evidence: Step 17: Agent creates /app/Makefile with content 'all: $(MAKE) -C src all' and 'clean: $(MAKE) -C src clean', a design that permanently places the binary in /app/src; no subsequent step modifies this to copy or build the executable into /app.
t_surface_evidence: Step 19: Running 'cd /app && make all' produces output 'make -C src all' and 'make[1]: Entering directory /app/src' followed by the binary being linked as 'test_program' inside /app/src; this observable output shows /app/test_program is never created.
trigger_explanation: At step 10 the agent acts on the unverified assumption that modifying /app/src/Makefile (the existing build file in the subdirectory) is the correct target and that running make from /app by delegation is equivalent to producing /app/test_program. The agent saw in step 6 that no Makefile existed in /app and gfortran was available, but never consulted what artifact path or build interface the tests require before committing to the src-centric approach.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 11-12: 'make clean' and 'make all' via 'make -C src' both produce output showing 'make: Entering directory /app/src', clearly indicating the executable is built inside src rather than at /app. Step 12 shows 'gfortran ... -o test_program ...' running inside /app/src. These signals before the t_commit at step 17 indicate the artifact will end up in the wrong location.
